## Services

- [3D Interactive Web](https://www.codeics.me/services/3d-interactive-web): WebGL experiences engineered with Three.js and React Three Fiber running at 60fps. Includes custom GLSL shaders, GSAP camera timelines, Draco/KTX2 asset pipelines, and progressive fallbacks. Starting from $1,500.
- [AI Web Apps](https://www.codeics.me/services/ai-web-apps): Production-ready AI features embedded into React 19 applications. Includes semantic vector search with Supabase pgvector, streaming LLM workflows, and secure edge execution. Starting from $2,000.
- [Enterprise WordPress](https://www.codeics.me/services/enterprise-wordpress): Headless and classic WordPress builds with bespoke Gutenberg block libraries, WPGraphQL, and hardened CDN caching. Starting from $1,150.
- [UI/UX Design Systems](https://www.codeics.me/services/ui-ux-design-systems): Token-based Figma design systems mapped directly to Tailwind CSS architectures adhering to WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards. Starting from $1,000.
- [Web Performance Audits](https://www.codeics.me/services/web-performance-audits): Field (CrUX) and lab audits targeting 95+ Lighthouse scores and Core Web Vitals remediation (LCP, INP, CLS). Starting from $500.

## Selected Work

- [Lumen 3D Landing](https://www.codeics.me/work/lumen-3d-interactive-landing): Interactive WebGL landing experience featuring dynamic camera controls and shader motion.
- [Atlas AI Workspace](https://www.codeics.me/work/atlas-ai-research-workspace): Full-stack AI application with vector indexing and streaming chat architecture.
- [Vantage Performance Overhaul](https://www.codeics.me/work/vantage-performance-rebuild): Architecture refactor achieving sub-second LCP and zero layout shifts.
- [Orbit Design System](https://www.codeics.me/work/orbit-design-system): Production-ready Tailwind UI library with dark luxury aesthetic.
